scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:packages && bun run typecheck:examples
scripts.example:build:apps: bun run --filter retina-example-web build && bun run --filter retina-example-expo build
scripts.example:build: bun run example:build:apps && bun run --filter retina-example-api typecheck
scripts.example:check:prod: VITE_RETINA_TEST_MODE=0 EXPO_PUBLIC_RETINA_TEST_MODE=0 bun run example:build:apps && node examples/scripts/check-test-markers.mjs --expect=absent examples/web/dist examples/expo/dist/ios examples/expo/dist/android
scripts.example:check:test: VITE_RETINA_TEST_MODE=1 EXPO_PUBLIC_RETINA_TEST_MODE=1 VITE_BUILD_ID=retina-check EXPO_PUBLIC_BUILD_ID=retina-check bun run example:build:apps && node examples/scripts/check-test-markers.mjs --expect=present examples/web/dist examples/expo/dist/ios examples/expo/dist/android
